name: Kita (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kita ward emblem in black: a stylised device of a disc with pointed wings enclosing a small disc.
history: Municipal flag of Kita, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1952.

features.role: Kita ward emblem — a stylised device of a disc with pointed wings enclosing a small disc
